create_pjit_wrapper: create a pjit wrapper function that falls back to jax.jit on CPU platforms
build_mesh_from_submesh: build a JAX Mesh from a model parallel submesh spec for TPU or GPU devices
get_default_mesh: get a default 2D data-model Mesh for TPU v2/v3/v4 or GPU based on num_partitions
partition_function_with_pjit: partition a callable using PjitPartitioner with logical axis rules and named axes
configure_logical_axis_rules: configure standard logical axis rules mapping batch, vocab, mlp, heads to data or model axes
